about_short_description.short_description: Roundabout Technologies is a security services company that offers information security and cloud solutions.

product.name: Information Security
product.description: We help customers identify gaps in their network, websites, and digital assets, and provide end-to-end security audits and penetration testing.

identifier.value: Cloud Solution and Linux Server Installation

product.name: Cloud Solution and Linux Server Installation
product.description: We offer cloud solutions and Linux server installation services to support high-performance computing needs in various fields.

product.name: Managed Services
product.description: We manage IT operations, including server administration and central monitoring of IT infrastructure.

product.name: Server Virtualization
product.description: We provide server virtualization using hypervisor solutions to maximize server resource utilization.

product.name: Infrastructure Services
product.description: We offer central authentication, management, and monitoring services for IT infrastructure, including log collection and multi-factor authentication.

product.name: High Availability Services
product.description: We provide high availability solutions for web servers, applications, physical servers, network devices, and databases to minimize downtime.
